MEDIA TECHNOLOGY — TERMLY EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: MEDIA TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. Input Cable Tester

2. When learning Post- production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Post- production.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Post- production.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Post- production.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Post- production.

3. When learning Photography, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Photography.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Photography.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Photography.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Photography.

4. When learning Introduction to Media Technology 1.2 Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Prod, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   D. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Media Technology 1.2 Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Prod.

6. When learning Introduction to Media Technology, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Media Technology.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Media Technology.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Media Technology.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Media Technology.

7. When learning Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P.

   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P.

8. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Work alone with eyes closed

9. When learning Audio Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Audio Production.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Audio Production.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Audio Production.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Audio Production.

10. When learning Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photo, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   B. Monitor
   C. CPU
   D. Speaker

12. When learning Digital Video Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

14. When learning Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
